mcqs.question: Compared with no treatment, what does the review say PAP does?

options.A: It clinically significantly reduces severity, sleepiness, blood pressure, and motor vehicle accidents, and improves sleep-related quality of life
options.B: It has no effect on sleepiness
options.D: It is inferior to no treatment

mcqs.correctAnswerText: It clinically significantly reduces severity, sleepiness, blood pressure, and motor vehicle accidents, and improves sleep-related quality of life
mcqs.explanation: PAP compared with no treatment produced a clinically significant reduction in disease severity, sleepiness, blood pressure, and motor vehicle accidents, and an improvement in sleep-related quality of life.

sourceRefs.excerpt: The data demonstrated that PAP compared to no treatment results in a clinically significant reduction in disease severity, sleepiness, blood pressure, and motor vehicle accidents, and improvement in sleep-related quality of life in adults with OSA.

mcqs.question: How did home initiation of PAP compare with in-laboratory titration?

options.B: Home initiation was inferior on every outcome
options.C: Laboratory titration is required and home start is ineffective
options.E: Home initiation increased blood pressure only

mcqs.explanation: Initiation of PAP in the home demonstrated equivalent effects on patient outcomes compared with an in-laboratory titration approach.

sourceRefs.excerpt: the initiation of PAP in the home demonstrated equivalent effects on patient outcomes when compared to an in-laboratory titration approach.

mcqs.question: What did the review find for auto-adjusting or bilevel PAP compared with CPAP?

options.A: No clinically significant difference in patient outcomes

mcqs.correctAnswerText: No clinically significant difference in patient outcomes
mcqs.explanation: Auto-adjusting or bilevel PAP did not result in clinically significant differences in patient outcomes compared with standard continuous PAP.

sourceRefs.excerpt: the use of auto-adjusting or bilevel PAP did not result in clinically significant differences in patient outcomes compared with standard continuous PAP.

mcqs.question: Which added interventions improved PAP adherence?

options.A: Educational, behavioral, troubleshooting, and telemonitoring interventions
options.C: Only a change of machine brand

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Educational, behavioral, troubleshooting, and telemonitoring interventions
mcqs.explanation: The review reports a clinically significant improvement in adherence with educational, behavioral, troubleshooting, and telemonitoring interventions.

sourceRefs.excerpt: data demonstrated a clinically significant improvement in PAP adherence with the use of educational, behavioral, troubleshooting, and telemonitoring interventions.

mcqs.question: How did nasal interfaces compare with oronasal interfaces?

options.A: Nasal interfaces had improved adherence and slightly greater reductions in OSA severity
options.B: Oronasal interfaces were better on both adherence and severity
options.C: The interfaces were identical and not compared
options.E: Only full-face masks reduced the apnea-hypopnea index

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Nasal interfaces had improved adherence and slightly greater reductions in OSA severity
mcqs.explanation: Nasal interfaces compared with oronasal interfaces had improved adherence and slightly greater reductions in OSA severity.

sourceRefs.excerpt: nasal interfaces compared to oronasal interfaces have improved adherence and slightly greater reductions in OSA severity, heated humidification compared to no humidification reduces some continuous PAP-related side effects, and pressure profile PAP did not result in clinically significant differences in patient outcomes compared with standard continuous PAP.
